Professional Summary

Experienced AI and Generative Researcher with strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP). Proficient in Large Language Models (LLMs), Diffusion Models, and Multimodal Learning for text, image and video generation. Demonstrated success in healthcare, cybersecurity, and education applications. Over 8 years of university-level teaching experience and proven skills in model deployment and MLOps.

Research & Development Projects

  • AI-Assisted Policy/Procedure Data Extraction for Nursing Management — Developed AI systems to extract policy and procedure data, aiding management and decision-making in clinical nursing scenarios.
  • AI-Assisted Voice/Audio Documentation and Charting for RNs — Implemented voice-enabled documentation tools to streamline clinical workflows and reduce administrative burden.
  • AI to Mitigate Psychiatric Specialist Shortages — Designed AI-assisted diagnostic tools to support mental health practitioners and partially automate assessments.
  • AI-Assisted Documentation for Home Health & Hospice Nurses — Automated documentation solutions to free clinician time for patient care.
  • AI-Assisted Medication Prior Authorization — Systems to expedite prior authorization processes between providers, payers and pharmacies.
  • Driving Change: AI for Nurse-Led QI Projects — Applied AI to analyze and optimize nurse-led quality improvement initiatives.
  • AI-Assisted Patient Info Extraction for Health Alerts — Models that extract clinical cues and generate screening alerts.
  • Hospital-to-Home BP Pal — Remote blood-pressure monitoring solution to reduce readmissions.
  • Detection of TB from X-Ray Images — ViT-based pipeline using synthetic data generation and PyTorch fine-tuning for CXR classification.
  • Intelligent Detection of Tiny Cigarette Butts — DETR-based framework for object detection in waste-management video streams.
  • Fire Detection from Video — YOLOv8-based real-time fire detection system.
  • Urdu Navigation System for Visual Impairment — Vision-based navigation assistance using YOLOv8.
  • Image Generation from Urdu Text — Stable Diffusion pipeline adapted for Urdu caption-to-image generation.
  • Empathy Chatbot for Epilepsy Patients — Multimodal chatbot providing emotional support and guidance.
  • Multimodal Chatbot for Alzheimer’s Disease — Conversational assistant integrating vision and language for patient support.
  • Alzheimer Assistant — Dual-module system combining MRI-based Alzheimer stage prediction and LAB-RAG powered medical chatbot (98% accuracy).
  • Predictive Analytics Pipelines — XGBoost/LightGBM models for healthcare and forecasting applications.
